goal: NET dependency injection review: lifetimes, captive dependencies and service locator use.
use: NET dependency injection review: lifetimes, captive dependencies and service locator use. Use when services are registered with the built-in container.

steps.note: List the registrations and their lifetimes.
Check captive dependencies. A singleton must not hold a scoped or transient service.
Check the locator. Flag services resolved from the provider inside business code.
Check disposal. Flag transient disposables registered as singletons.
Report. Each registration with file and line, the problem and the fix.
